data.title: Data we process
data.body: When you visit the website, technically necessary data is processed, for example your IP address and the date and time of access. If you create a customer account, write to us via the contact form or offer a vehicle, we process the information you enter, such as your name, email address, phone number and vehicle details.

purposes.title: Purposes of processing
purposes.body: We process your data to provide the website, answer your enquiries, manage your customer account and handle vehicle offers and trade-ins.

cookies.title: Cookies and sessions

rights.title: Your rights
